newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL-Portugal 3-yr bonds may not be fully placed.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Portugal 3-yr bonds may not be fully placed.

text.p: The following is the forecast of analysts from five banks and one brokerage for Tuesday's auction of 25 billion escudos of three-year bonds (March 2000) by the Institute for Public Credit Management (IGCP).
But the analysts were divided on whether the IGCP would accept bids for the full amount, with two saying it would and four believing it would not.
The March 2000 closed on the secondary market (OTC) at 5.26 percent, 25 basis points above its Spanish equivalent.
Despite the expectations for a favourable inflation figure for June, the market is still not ready to bet on a rate cut by the Bank of Portugal, analysts said.
However, they added that the Institute would not be prepared to pay more than 30 basis points above the Spanish Bono.
They said that the best chance of the full amount being placed would be if non-residents saw the auction as an opportunity for arbitrage with the Bonos.
